networkAccess.reasoning: Token extraction is fully client-side. Two optional features dial out: the delivery step POSTs the generated package to a user-configured receiver endpoint (which may be any host — local, Tailscale, CI), so the domain can't be fixed ahead of time; and the agent listener talks to a loopback bridge the designer runs themselves. Loopback is listed explicitly alongside the wildcard because a published plugin is judged by this field and the two local endpoints are the ones whose failure would be silent.
